card.title: IPad Pro 11 Not turning on, drawing no current with little ticking noise repair

source.title: IPad Pro 11 Not turning on, drawing no current with little ticking noise repair

claims.statement: iPad Pro 11 (2018) not powering with a ticking noise and no current was traced to shorted cap C3800 on a PMIC/CD3217 line.
The two middle battery pins (CLK and DAT0) can be damaged when the battery is lifted; a straight jumper from board to battery fixes it.

procedure: Check for short at C3800; remove/replace.
Inspect the battery data pins; jumper if broken.
card.caveats: Single case. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
